usage_notes: Advertised-only endpoint record from the official Zhipu docs (docs.bigmodel.cn) captured 2026-08-17; no controlled qualification observation has run against this endpoint yet.

Subscription-plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 with a Coding-Plan-specific API key. Official docs state that Coding Plan, Token Plan, and pay-as-you-go keys and base URLs are fully isolated and must be used in matching pairs; mixing them causes 401/403 or unexpected pay-as-you-go billing.

Same host as the pay-as-you-go endpoint (open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4); the required_base_path /api/coding/paas/v4 plus the dedicated credential variable keep the two identities separate. The Bailian-hosted glm-5.2 route is a different provider, endpoint, and model version entirely.
